opportunity.description: Army Contracting Command-Aberdeen Proving Ground, on behalf of HQDA G-4, seeks mature commercial technology that captures body and foot measurements by automated non-contact methods and translates them into recommended standard Army uniform and footwear sizes. Current manual tape measurement at accession points causes bottlenecks and high uniform and boot return rates and keeps no record of sizing changes over time. Evaluation phases and required attributes are in Attachment 1. Questions were due Oct 13 2026. No set-aside used.

rationale.point: The Army seeks a mature commercial technology for contactless body and foot measurement (claim #1), which is outside the company's demonstrated expertise in network monitoring and help desk services.

The Call for Solutions is issued under Army Open Solicitation W9128Z-25-S-A002 (claim #2), but the company has no known past performance with ACC-APG or HQDA G-4 and the set-aside is NONE, removing any 8(a) competitive advantage.

risks: Significant technology gap: no existing product or relevant R&D for automated sizing capture.
Extremely short response window (due 2026-10-20) limits ability to form a credible team or proposal.
Full and open competition against likely larger, more experienced vendors in this niche.
Company's facility clearance not yet granted and FedRAMP not started may hinder compliance if a contract requires them.
nextSteps: Immediately assess if any commercial-off-the-shelf sizing solution can be partnered with or resold under a teaming agreement.
Contact ACC-APG to clarify evaluation criteria and determine if a response without a mature prototype is viable.
Evaluate whether the 8(a) program can facilitate a mentor-protégé arrangement for this specific technology area.
Make a go/no-go decision by 2026-10-17 to allow minimal proposal preparation time.

classification.summary: The Army needs a mature commercial technology that automatically captures body and foot measurements without contact to generate recommended uniform and footwear sizes, reducing bottlenecks and return rates.
